name: @factoidal/lean
description: The Lean 4 engine of Factoidal as a single WebAssembly module: RDF parsing (N-Triples, N-Quads, Turtle, TriG, RDF/XML), SPARQL 1.1/1.2 query and update, RDFS / rho-df / RDFS-Plus / OWL-RL closures, and RDFC-1.0 canonicalization, extracted from the L4Factoidal formal source. Companion to @factoidal/core, which resolves it through its factoidal/l4 and factoidal/l4-core subpaths.
